name: SUNRAY·FINANCE
rootCause: SUNRAY FINANCE experienced a private key compromise, allowing the exploiter to gain control of the SUN and ARC tokens and sell them off, draining the funds from DEX pairs. So far, the attacker has stolen approximately $2.855 million.

descriptions.text: SUNRAY FINANCE experienced a private key compromise, allowing the exploiter to gain control of the SUN and ARC tokens and sell them off, draining the funds from DEX pairs. So far, the attacker has stolen approximately $2.855 million.

Sunray Finance suffered a critical exploit on Arbitrum One on 30 October 2024 after a management contract upgrade enabled by a leaked private key. The attacker minted enormous volumes of SUN tokens and drained approximately $2.85 million in stablecoins and ETH liquidity pools. The attacker obtained the protocol's management contract private key on Arbitrum, allowing a malicious upgrade and unauthorized SUN token minting. This enabled the draining of DEX liquidity pools linked to SUN and ARC tokens.

A perpetuals trading platform called Sunray Finance was hacked on October 30 by an attacker who was able to upgrade a smart contract used by the protocol. They then were able to mint a massive number of the protocol's SUN token — 200 sextillion, to be precise. Then, they cashed out what they were able to, crashing the SUN token price in the process. Ultimately, the attacker made off with about $2.1 million of the Tether stablecoin.
